name: Hong Kong Restaurant
addr: 3691 El Camino Real, Palo Alto, CA 94306
founded: 2000 (El Camino Real location; long-standing Palo Alto institution)
audience: Palo Alto families, Stanford and university visitors, business lunches, large toasts
description: Cantonese seafood and dim sum house on El Camino Real serving four hundred and fifty-five worth of accumulated reviews: whole fish, BBQ, banquet tables and weekend yum cha.
serviceCopy: Weekend dim sum, from carts to a la carte.
Whole fish and roast meats, prepared to order.
Lunch sets for the offices up the road.
insight: 455 reviews and 984 photos is a content library most restaurants would pay for; a site could be built entirely from what already exists.
usps: Twenty-five years of Cantonese consistency on El Camino Real
Banquet rooms that seat the extended family
A photo archive of actual dishes, not stock food
differentiators: Publishes a real menu with allergens, banquet packages and reservation routing instead of a template one-pager
persona: The family Cantonese table of Palo Alto

reputation.note: Do not publish a rating figure until the current score is verified.

afford: A full-service restaurant with banquet capability and a leased Palo Alto building
Already listed on ordering platforms: they pay for distribution
risk: Restaurant margins cap the budget; scope must be a booking and menu engine, not a brand film
Kitchen-led updates: the menu page must be editable in minutes

art.logo: Existing signage is a calligraphic lockup - vectorise it and set it properly
art.photoNote: Steam, lazy susan, BBQ window, banquet table

copy.h1: The banquet table your family already knows.
copy.sub: Cantonese seafood, dim sum and large-format family dining on El Camino Real - with a menu you can actually read.
copy.lede: Nine hundred photographs of this kitchen exist online and none of them are on its website, which today is a one-page ordering template with a misspelt header and no address.
svcCopy: Weekend dim sum, from carts to a la carte.
Whole fish and roast meats, prepared to order.
Lunch sets for the offices up the road.

concept.dir: Menu-forward restaurant site: a proper bilingual-feeling type hierarchy, dish index with real photography, banquet package table, and reservation routing. Warm paper tones, vermilion accents, no app-store chrome.
interactive: Menu page as a designed index (courses, allergens, prices from client data)
Dish photo mosaic with hover captions
Banquet enquiry form with headcount bands
Reservation and call-first routing bar (mobile sticky)
concept.refs: A neighbourhood institution treated with the care of a flagship.

web.note: Audited live: the domain itself carries a typo (restauranpl) and the site is an ordering-template one-pager - menu anchors labelled with placeholders, a misspelt Prok header, no address, no hours, no about. 984 customer photos exist on the listing; the site uses none of them.

design.summary: Menu-first layout with dish cards, spice/level chips, split-screen hero of signature plate, hours + reservation bar that survives mobile.
